text_block_list.text:
Today's the day for tryouts. The academy's
up-and-coming runners
participate in
order to prove their skills to the
prospective trainers
who've come to watch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wondering what this fresh batch of
newcomers has to show, I also
make my
way to the racetrack.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
C'mooon! I wanna run too! Let me gooo
iiin!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган, please behave yourself.
You can't just run onto the
track without
permission! Goodness, you're too fast for
your own
good...
text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff A

text_block_list.text: I don't caaare! I wanna race toooo!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
A short distance away from the track, I
spot Маяно Топ Ган and the
race
attendant butting heads.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thbbft! Catch me if you can! ...Bwah?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Attempting to flee, Маяно Топ Ган
dashes away, bumping into me
in the
process. Without so much as a second
thought, I catch her
mid-fall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uhhhh, sorry! Are you okay?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I-I'm okay... since you caught me and
everything.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You're actually pretty nice! You a
new Тренер? My name's
Mayano Top Gun!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect timing. Would you mind
watching her and making sure she
doesn't
run off onto the racetrack? I'd really
appreciate it.
text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff A

text_block_list.text: Wait, whaaat? What'd you say yes for?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I thought you were a nice trainer!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: What's with the commotion?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Runners, it's time. Please prepare
yourselves for the race!
text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff A

text_block_list.text: Hm... it's time.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Though the whining and nagging
continues, Маяно Топ Ган is
unable to
get her way, and the race proceeds
without her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The racers are off to a fantastic start! All
eyes are on Нарита Брайан!
What kind of
performance can we expect to see from
her today?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Too slow.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Look at her go! Нарита Брайан is closing in on
the front!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Awww, must be nice to be able to race... I
wanted to run toooo! This
is so boooring!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey, could we at least chat about
something? Do you have any funny

stories?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган continues to pester me,
but she suddenly shifts her
gaze in the
direction of the course and mutters
something under her
breath.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh man, that scary-looking girl looks like she's about to go whoosh.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: It's over!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Just as Маяно Топ Ган predicted, Narita
Brian picks up her pace
and bolts forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's like she knew what was going to
happen next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Was it coincidence? Or is it something else
entirely?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is flying ahead! She's weaving
her way through the other
racers! Her eyes
are set on first place!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wow, she's good!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Wait, that racer in second place...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I hear Маяно Топ Ган, and without
thinking, turn my attention
toward the
second place runner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From her current position, as long as she
times it right, she could
prevent Narita
Brian from overtaking.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If executed successfully, she will even gain
an open path into the
homestretch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: If she goes for it like bam at the right time, then all she has to do is go zoom until she reaches the finish line!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: The right time is... ah, now!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Outta my way!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Wah! No waaay!
text_block_list.name: Second-place Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Aw, maaan. She totally blew it.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Although the other Umamusume has lost
her chance to maintain her
lead, Mayano
Top Gun's read of the situation was
impeccable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If she had been the one out there running,
then perhaps the outcome
would've been
different...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: C'mon, why couldn't I run in today's race?! This sucks!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's up with you? Why are you
staring at me like that?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Don't tell me... Have you fallen head over heels for me?! Oh my gosh, I really am that cute! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
The race ended in a resounding victory for
Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the trainers are clamoring around her in
hopes of scouting such a
promising talent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I, on the other hand, have something else
on my mind...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh man, that scary-looking girl looks like she's about to go whoosh.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: If she goes for it like bam at the right time, then all she has to do is go zoom until she reaches the finish line!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Although Маяно Топ Ган may lack
eloquence, the young racer's

understanding of the race and its
competitors was on another level.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel like I have only caught
a glimpse of the raw
potential she
possesses...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
